description: Form 8962 in miniature for tax year 2026 (returns filed in 2027), for a full year with the same household and plan: the premium tax credit allowed on final income versus the advance payments on Form 1095-A, and the excess to repay (no repayment cap from 2026) or the extra credit to claim.

advance_annual.description: Form 1095-A column C (advance payments), summed for the year.

annual_income.description: Final 2026 household income (modified AGI) in dollars.

benchmark_annual.description: Form 1095-A column B (benchmark plan premium), summed for the year.

enrolled_premium_annual.description: Form 1095-A column A (your plan's premiums), summed. Defaults to the benchmark amount.

state.description: Two-letter state code (e.g. TX, CA, DC) or full state name.

name: estimate_tax_credit_repayment
title: Estimate 2026 premium tax credit repayment (Form 8962)
